strings.text: The Fisherman and his Soul

A young fisherman nets a little mermaid and loves her. To go down to her he must send his soul away — and the soul goes into the world without a heart, wearing his face. Every choice is between the one he loves and the one he was.
strings.translation: 一個年輕的漁夫用網撈起一條小美人魚，愛上了她。為了下海去找她，他必須送走自己的靈魂——而靈魂帶著他的臉，沒有心，走進了這個世界。每一次選擇，都是在他所愛的她和從前的自己之間。

strings.text: To love her wholly he cuts away his soul — and the soul learns from the world without a heart.
strings.translation: 為了全心全意愛她，他割捨了自己的靈魂——而靈魂在沒有心的情況下，向這個世界學習。

strings.text: after the fairy tale by Oscar Wilde
The Shadow at his Feet
The girl dancing on the pier
Stopped, and danced
Your shadow on the boards danced with you.
strings.translation: 木板上你的影子，和你一起跳著舞。

strings.text: Passed by, looked back once
strings.translation: 走了過去，回頭看了一次

strings.text: You looked back once.
The Witch
“You promised.”
She threw the knife at your feet and turned away to the well.
strings.translation: 她把刀扔在你腳邊，轉身朝井邊走去。

strings.text: “Again. Without him. Till dawn.”
Her hand stayed on yours on the knife. The Mermaid smelled the wood on you.
strings.translation: 她的手仍壓在你握刀的手上。美人魚在你身上聞到了森林的氣味。

strings.text: The heart
“And what would I love her with?”
“Then I shall be cruel. You chose it yourself.”
strings.translation: 「那我就殘酷給你看。這是你自己選的。」

strings.text: Not to look. To cut.
The Soul fell silent in the middle of a word.
strings.translation: 靈魂話說到一半，就沉默了。

strings.text: “Come here once a year”
The Mermaid heard that you would go out to another.
strings.translation: 美人魚聽說你要出去找另一個人。

strings.text: Be my wife
You have a human soul. Send it away — and I will love you
strings.translation: 你有人類的靈魂。把它送走——我就會愛你

strings.text: What use is a soul to me? I have never seen it. Never touched it. I do not know it
strings.translation: 靈魂對我有什麼用？我從來沒看過它。從來沒摸過它。我根本不認識它

strings.text: Send it away — and come
I will come tomorrow
What is “tomorrow”?
Father, I love a girl of the sea. My soul is in the way. How do I send it away?
strings.translation: 神父，我愛上了一個海裡的女孩。我的靈魂礙了我的事。要怎麼把它送走？

strings.text: The soul is worth more than all the gold in the world. The sea-folk are accursed. Keep away from them
strings.translation: 靈魂比世上所有的黃金還要珍貴。海裡的族類是受詛咒的。離他們遠一點

strings.text: If it is worth so much — I do not need it
strings.translation: 既然它這麼珍貴——我就不需要它

strings.text: Begone!
By the well in the fir wood lives one who knows
strings.translation: 冷杉林的井邊住著一個女人。她知道

strings.text: Stop
A girl dancing barefoot on the boards.
strings.translation: 一個女孩光著腳在木板上跳舞。

strings.text: Dance, fisherman!
What do you want? Wind? Fish? No. I know. To send your soul away
strings.translation: 你想要什麼？風？魚？不對。我知道。要送走你的靈魂

strings.text: Tell me how
The price is a dance. Tonight, at full moon, here
strings.translation: 代價是一支舞。今晚，月圓的時候，在這裡

strings.text: Only a dance?
Only
Bow to him
You broke the dance. The bargain is not kept
strings.translation: 你把舞破壞了。約定不算數

strings.text: You promised
I promised
Take it. Cut. You will see for yourself what comes of a man without one
strings.translation: 拿去。割吧。你自己會看到，一個人沒有了它會怎樣

strings.text: Again. Without him. Till dawn
strings.translation: 再跳一次。不要他。跳到天亮

strings.text: And the rule was this: at moonrise stand by the water with your back to the moon. The shadow at your feet is the body of your soul. Cut it from your feet with this knife, the knife with the handle of green snakeskin
strings.translation: 規則是這樣的：月亮升起時，背對著月亮站在水邊。你腳邊的影子，就是你靈魂的身體。用這把刀把它從你腳邊割下來，就是這把綠色蛇皮刀柄的刀

strings.text: You smell of the wood
I have been with you all your life. Do not drive me away. And if you do — do not send me without a heart. The world is cruel. Give me your heart; with it I shall not be lost
strings.translation: 我陪了你一輩子。不要趕我走。如果你一定要趕——也不要讓我沒有心就走。這世界很殘酷。把你的心給我，有了它我就不會迷失

strings.text: Not look at it. Cut.
“My heart is hers. But come here once a year — I will come out to you.”
strings.translation: 「我的心是她的。不過你每年來這裡一次——我會出來見你。」

strings.text: And what would I love her with, then?
Then I shall be cruel. You chose it yourself. Once a year I will come here and call
strings.translation: 那我就會變得殘酷。這是你自己選的。每年我會來這裡一次，呼喚你

strings.text: Once a year I will come and…
My heart is hers. But come here once a year. I will come out to you
strings.translation: 我的心是她的。不過你每年來這裡一次。我會出來見你

strings.text: I will come. You promised
And the sea took him
Three Years
Till sunrise
Sat beside the Soul
Her song broke off; all that day she sat with her back to you.
strings.translation: 她的歌聲斷了；那一整天，她都背對著你坐著。

strings.text: Went to her song
The Soul put out the lantern.
One day
“I’ll go. One day.”
The water closed over the stone.
“No. I stay.”
The Soul went into the world alone, with your face.
strings.translation: 靈魂頂著你的臉，獨自走進了世界。

strings.text: A year went by like a single evening
strings.translation: 一年過去了，就像一個傍晚

strings.text: Come out
You promised. Here I am
I have been in the East. There in a cave is the Mirror of Wisdom: whoever looks in it knows everything. I hid it for you. Come
strings.translation: 我去過東方。那裡的山洞裡有一面智慧之鏡：誰往裡面看，就能知道一切。我替你把它藏起來了。走吧

strings.text: Love is better than wisdom. And I am loved
strings.translation: 愛比智慧更好。而且有人愛我

strings.text: The first year.
Do not go near her. Whoever has her in him is not ours. That is how it is with us
strings.translation: 不要靠近她。誰身上有她，誰就不屬於我們。我們這裡就是這樣

strings.text: Then sit with me till sunrise. Only sit. For a year I have talked to myself
strings.translation: 那就陪我坐到日出吧。只要坐著就好。這一年來我都在跟自己說話

strings.text: Sit on the edge of the pier, beside her
strings.translation: 在棧橋邊坐下，坐在她旁邊

strings.text: Go to her song
The song from the stone broke off in the middle; and all that day, down below, she sat with her back to him
strings.translation: 石頭那邊的歌聲唱到一半就斷了；那一整天，她在水底下都背對著他坐著

strings.text: I have been in the South. The Ring of Riches. Come
strings.translation: 我去過南方。財富之戒。走吧

strings.text: Love is better than riches
The second year, the same day.
Like this — the way they do on the pier
strings.translation: 像這樣——像在棧橋上那樣

strings.text: Show me how you dance here
strings.translation: 跳給我看，你們這裡是怎麼跳舞的

strings.text: We do not dance. Dancing is done with feet
strings.translation: 我們不跳舞。跳舞要用腳

strings.text: The third year.
On the square beyond the bridge, where you sold your fish, a girl dances at night. You were never there at night. Her feet are like little white doves. Come. One day
strings.translation: 在橋那頭的廣場上，就是你賣魚的地方，每天晚上有個女孩在跳舞。你晚上從來沒去過那裡。她的腳就像兩隻小小的白鴿。走吧。一天就好

strings.text: You want to see feet, don’t you? Hers has none
strings.translation: 你想看看腳，對吧？你那位可是沒有腳的

strings.text: I am tired of walking alone. You will look — and come back
strings.translation: 我厭倦了一個人走。你看一看——就回來

strings.text: You stopped that time on the pier. I remember — I danced with you
strings.translation: 那次在棧橋上你停了下來。我記得——我跟你一起跳了舞

strings.text: You looked back that time on the pier. I remember
strings.translation: 那次在棧橋上你回頭看了。我記得

strings.text: To walk on the earth, let me in. On the shore I will come out again
strings.translation: 要在陸地上走，就讓我進去。到了岸上我會再出來

strings.text: I’ll go. One day
I will come back
No. I stay
As you like. Your face will be useful to me
strings.translation: 隨你。你的臉對我會很有用

strings.text: Then I will go alone. With your face
strings.translation: 那我就自己走。帶著你的臉

strings.text: The Town
Without Him
Wait for the dancer
“I’ll wait till tomorrow.”
In the night your hands took the cup.
strings.translation: 夜裡，你的雙手拿起了杯子。

strings.text: “No. Back, now.”
You never learned whether there was a dancer.
strings.translation: 究竟有沒有那位舞者，你始終不知道。

strings.text: The cup
“It was I who took it.”
The little girl hid behind her father.
strings.translation: 小女孩躲到了父親身後。

strings.text: Put it back quietly
The cup was back on the shelf. The little girl was watching.
His lantern over the bridge
Rose to look
That evening she sang no more.
strings.translation: 那天傍晚，她不再唱歌了。

strings.text: Did not lift his head
She laid her palm over your eyes and sang on.
strings.translation: 她用手掌蓋住你的眼睛，繼續唱下去。

strings.text: The last call
“I’ll go. I’ll give the cup back.”
She saw, and went under.
strings.translation: 她看見了，然後沉入水中。

strings.text: “No.”
The Soul will not come again.
The cup, at the potter’s door
“A thief — and came.” He was slow to shut the door.
strings.translation: 「賊——居然還敢來。」他關門關得很慢。

strings.text: “I found it by the bridge.”
“Found it, then.” The door shut at once.
She dances at night
Do you hear? Music
He felt chilly, though it was warm
strings.translation: 天氣明明溫暖，他卻覺得發冷

strings.text: The fisherman from the bay? Three years nobody saw you
strings.translation: 海灣的漁夫？三年沒人見過你了

strings.text: A girl dances here…
A dancer? Never seen one. Who knows who dances of an evening
strings.translation: 跳舞的女孩？沒見過。傍晚誰在跳舞，誰知道呢

strings.text: She will be here tomorrow. I swear by the moon
strings.translation: 她明天會來。我對月亮發誓

strings.text: Sleep at my place, if you are waiting. It is cold
strings.translation: 你要等的話，就到我家睡吧。外面冷

strings.text: I’ll wait till tomorrow
My wife’s. We drank from it at our wedding
strings.translation: 我太太的。我們結婚時用它喝過酒

strings.text: No. Back, now
And from within — not a laugh: silence
strings.translation: 從體內傳來的——不是笑聲，而是沉默

strings.text: The little girl saw the guest walk with his eyes shut, and shut her own. The Fisherman did not know
strings.translation: 小女孩看見客人閉著眼睛走路，自己也閉上了眼。漁夫並不知道

strings.text: The cup… My wife’s. Have you seen it?
strings.translation: 杯子……我太太的。你有沒有看到？

strings.text: Hush
I don’t remember how. But the hands are mine
strings.translation: 我不記得是怎麼回事。但手是我的

strings.text: I gave you bread. Go
You said: I
Not sure. And not being sure — he keeps quiet
strings.translation: 不確定。既然不確定——他就不作聲

strings.text: There it is! Rolled behind the bread
strings.translation: 在這裡！滾到麵包後面去了

strings.text: You see — nobody knows. Like me
strings.translation: 你看——誰也不知道。就像我一樣

strings.text: You won’t wait for the evening? Quite right. There is no dancer. There never was
strings.translation: 你不等到晚上了？這樣才對。根本沒有跳舞的女孩。從來就沒有

strings.text: You are cruel
You sent me away without a heart. I learned from the world
strings.translation: 你把我送走，卻沒給我心。我是向這個世界學的

strings.text: You did not give me my day. And she does dance, you know. You never looked
strings.translation: 你沒有給我那一天。而且她真的會跳舞喔。你始終沒去看

strings.text: And the Soul went over the earth alone
strings.translation: 而靈魂獨自走遍了大地

strings.text: Rise
A warm light far above, going away.
strings.translation: 高高在上的一點溫暖的光，正在遠去。

strings.text: From below she pulled him by the hand, without a word; and that evening she sang no more
strings.translation: 她在底下默默拉著他的手；那天晚上，她沒有再唱歌

strings.text: The fisherman from the bay? Three years nobody saw you. Sleep at my place; it is cold
strings.translation: 海灣的漁夫？三年沒人見過你了。到我家睡吧；外面冷

strings.text: The one with his face and his lantern is the Soul: people see the Fisherman.
strings.translation: 帶著他的臉和他的提燈的，是靈魂：人們看到的是漁夫。

strings.text: Fisherman!..
The fisherman from the bay is a thief
By morning the whole market knows: the fisherman from the bay is a thief.
strings.translation: 到了早上，整個市場都知道了：海灣的漁夫是個小偷。

strings.text: Your hands did it. I have no others
strings.translation: 是你的手做的。我沒有別的手

strings.text: Take it back
Give it back? I don’t know how. Give it back with your own hands — or not at all
strings.translation: 還回去？我不會。要嘛你用自己的手去還——要嘛就別還

strings.text: I call for the last time. Next year I shall forget the way
strings.translation: 這是我最後一次呼喚你。明年我就會忘記這條路了

strings.text: The fourth year.
I’ll go. I’ll give the cup back
strings.translation: 我去。我會把杯子還回去

strings.text: I’ll give it back — and come back
No
You!..
The town by the bridge, the same day; the Soul is in him.
It was I who took it
Came himself… A thief — and came
strings.translation: 自己來了……一個小偷——居然來了

strings.text: I found it by the bridge
He had seen the face that night
strings.translation: 那天夜裡，他看見過那張臉

strings.text: Found it, then
There. Now back to your fish
strings.translation: 好了。現在回去找你的魚吧

strings.text: The Shore
A night at sea
Went out for the night
The widow’s children saw her first.
strings.translation: 寡婦的孩子最先看見了她。

strings.text: Stayed by the water
The children went away over the bridge, nowhere.
strings.translation: 孩子們沿著橋走遠了，不知去向。

strings.text: The wave
Stayed with her
The wave covered the two of you.
Drew her away from the water
You laid her in the earth, not in the sea.
strings.translation: 你把她葬在土裡，而不是海裡。

strings.text: You swore by the sea to come whenever I call. I am calling!
strings.translation: 你對著大海發過誓，只要我呼喚，你就會來。我在呼喚你！

strings.text: You always came by yourself… Come
And the oath answered: from the deep, the four notes of her song — and they broke off on the third
strings.translation: 誓言回應了：從深處傳來她歌聲裡的四個音——唱到第三個就斷了

strings.text: He had nothing to call her by. From the deep came the same four notes
strings.translation: 他沒有東西可以呼喚她。深處傳來同樣的四個音

strings.text: He had nothing to call her by. Only the water
strings.translation: 他沒有東西可以呼喚她。只有水

strings.text: I’ll cut you off again
Come out. You promised to come out on the shore
strings.translation: 出來。你答應過到了岸上就會出來

strings.text: I promised. I lied
A knife cuts once. You cut me off yourself
strings.translation: 刀只能割一次。是你自己把我割下來的

strings.text: I told you: you will see for yourself
strings.translation: 我說過了：你自己會看到

strings.text: The night is long. It is warm by the well
Go to her. She is warm. She has feet
strings.translation: 去找她吧。她很溫暖。她有腳

strings.text: There are no fish. When the ice goes, we’ll leave. Somewhere
strings.translation: 沒有魚了。等冰化了，我們就走。隨便去哪裡

strings.text: The boat is rotting. Take it, if you need it
strings.translation: 船在爛了。你要的話，就拿去吧

strings.text: You are the best fisherman in the bay. Go out for one night — for them. What harm is there?
strings.translation: 你是海灣裡最好的漁夫。出海一個晚上——為了他們。這有什麼不好？

strings.text: Go out for the night
Stay
I tempted you with evil and with good. Let me at least into your heart — to be one, as before
strings.translation: 我用惡誘惑過你，也用善誘惑過你。至少讓我進到你的心裡吧——像從前那樣合而為一

strings.text: Come in
I cannot. It is all taken up with her
strings.translation: 我進不去。你的心全被她佔滿了

strings.text: If the boat goes out — we’ll stay
strings.translation: 既然船能出海——我們就留下來

strings.text: I loved you more than wisdom. More than riches. You called — and I did not hear
strings.translation: 我愛你勝過智慧。勝過財富。你呼喚過我——我卻沒有聽見

strings.text: Home! Run!
Run! The sea is coming!
The sea cast you out…
Stay with her
Draw her away from the water
His heart broke — and the Soul went into his heart
strings.translation: 他的心碎了——靈魂進入了他的心

strings.text: It went in without a word, and he shuddered with cold
strings.translation: 靈魂一句話也沒說就進去了，他冷得打了個哆嗦

strings.text: I am home
Epilogue
I will not bless the sea. Accursed are the sea-folk, and accursed are they who go with them
strings.translation: 我不會為大海祝福。海裡的族類是受詛咒的，跟他們在一起的人也是受詛咒的

strings.text: He sold his soul — and turned thief
strings.translation: 他出賣了靈魂——還當了小偷

strings.text: White Flowers
Bury them in the corner of the field where the linen is bleached. With no sign
strings.translation: 把他們埋在漂白亞麻布的那片田野的角落。不要立任何記號

strings.text: A Lantern on the Pier
Who is here?
She is from the sea
And a thief, they say
She shall not lie in holy ground. And you — come away from her. Begone!
strings.translation: 她不准躺在聖地裡。還有你——離她遠一點。滾開！

strings.text: The same morning as the last call.
strings.translation: 最後一次呼喚的那個早晨。

strings.text: Two Lights
The fisherman from the bay sold his soul — and see, now he thieves from town to town
strings.translation: 海灣的漁夫出賣了靈魂——你們看，現在他在各個城裡偷東西

strings.text: Sold! He gave it away for nothing — I saw
strings.translation: 出賣！他是白白送掉的——我親眼看見

strings.text: Years later.
Three years went by. On the altar lay white flowers such as no one had ever seen. The Priest meant to speak of wrath — and spoke of love, not knowing why himself
strings.translation: 三年過去了。祭壇上放著誰也沒見過的白色花朵。神父本來要講憤怒——卻講起了愛，連他自己也不知道為什麼

strings.text: Where are the flowers from?
From the corner of the field where the linen is bleached
strings.translation: 從漂白亞麻布的那片田野的角落

strings.text: To that corner the widow’s children carried shells: they had stayed, and the boat went out again
strings.translation: 寡婦的孩子們把貝殼帶到那個角落去：他們留下來了，那艘船又出海了

strings.text: To that corner nobody went
In the morning the Priest went down to the sea and blessed everything — the water, the fish, the sea-folk. But the sea-folk had left the bay, and there were never flowers in that corner again
strings.translation: 早上，神父走到海邊，為一切祝福——海水、魚，還有海裡的族類。可是海裡的族類已經離開了海灣，那個角落再也沒有開過花

strings.text: Far off, at the edge of hearing, four notes, going away out of the bay
strings.translation: 遠遠地，在幾乎聽不見的地方，四個音，正離開海灣

strings.text: Three springs went by, and on the mound grew white flowers such as no one had seen. The Priest set them on the altar; he meant to speak of wrath — and spoke of love
strings.translation: 過了三個春天，墳丘上長出了誰也沒見過的白色花朵。神父把它們放上祭壇；他本來要講憤怒——卻講起了愛

strings.text: The next day he blessed the sea. But the sea-folk had left the bay
strings.translation: 第二天，他為大海祝福。可是海裡的族類已經離開了海灣

strings.text: Many years later.
Sometimes he seems to hear three notes
strings.translation: 有時候，他好像聽見了三個音

strings.text: What is this — white?
Years
What are “years”?
Years on.
The Net
The net
For her word
She came whenever you called, and sang looking at the fish.
strings.translation: 你一呼喚她就來，一邊唱著歌，一邊看著魚。

strings.text: For nothing
She came by herself, when she wished — and some evenings the stone was empty.
strings.translation: 她想來的時候才自己來——有些傍晚，石頭上是空的。

strings.text: Every evening the young Fisherman went out upon the sea, and threw his nets into the water
strings.translation: 每天傍晚，年輕的漁夫都會出海，把漁網撒進水裡

strings.text: Either all the fish of the sea — or trouble
strings.translation: 要嘛是海裡所有的魚——要嘛是災禍

strings.text: Let me go! I am the only daughter of an old father. He is alone
strings.translation: 放我走！我是一個老父親唯一的女兒。他只有一個人

strings.text: And in the net, asleep, lay a little Mermaid. Her hair was like wet gold, and her tail was silver
strings.translation: 網裡睡著一條小美人魚。她的頭髮像濕漉漉的金子，尾巴是銀色的

strings.text: “I will let you go if you come whenever I call, and sing to me.”
strings.translation: 「我放你走，只要我呼喚，你就要來，唱歌給我聽。」

strings.text: “Swim.”
I will let you go if you come whenever I call, and sing to me
strings.translation: 我放你走，只要我呼喚，你就要來，唱歌給我聽

strings.text: I will come. I swear it by the sea
Swim
Do you want nothing?
And he had more fish than all the fishermen of the bay; but he looked only at the stone
strings.translation: 他的魚比海灣裡所有漁夫的都多；可是他只望著那塊石頭

strings.translation: 如果保留，這一章之後的章節就得重新玩一遍。

The Cup
A silver cup, a shelf, and the potter’s back.
strings.translation: 一只銀杯、一個架子，和陶匠的背影。

strings.text: The cup rings against the shelf.
strings.translation: 杯子碰到架子，噹地一響。

strings.text: The Dance
A tambourine, the full moon, and two dancing round the well.
strings.translation: 手鼓，滿月，兩個人繞著井跳舞。

strings.text: The Net, Up the Shore
His net with her in it, the sand, and the sea behind.
strings.translation: 他的網，網裡的她，沙灘，背後是大海。

strings.text: The net tears wider; the wave is at his knees.
strings.translation: 網破得更大了；浪已經到了他的膝蓋。

strings.text: Holding Her
Her cold hand, and the black wave coming.
strings.translation: 她冰冷的手，黑色的浪正湧過來。

strings.text: Her hand slipped out of his. The wave is nearer.
strings.translation: 她的手從他手裡滑脫了。浪更近了。

strings.text: The Knife
A long shadow on the boards, and a knife with a green snakeskin handle.
strings.translation: 木板上長長的影子，和一把綠色蛇皮刀柄的刀。

strings.text: The Knife, Again
A rusty knife, and a shadow that is one again.
strings.translation: 一把生鏽的刀，和又合而為一的影子。

strings.text: The blade goes through the shadow as through water.
strings.translation: 刀刃穿過影子，就像穿過水一樣。

strings.text: The net is heavy, and the boat heels.
A thread snaps at the edge of the net.
The Net, for the Children
The widow’s boat, his lantern on the bow, his net in the black water.
strings.translation: 寡婦的船，船頭掛著他的提燈，他的網在黑色的水裡。

strings.text: The net jerks, and half the catch slips back into the sea.
strings.translation: 網猛地一抖，一半的漁獲又滑回了海裡。

strings.text: The Post
The post of the pier, and the water below.
strings.translation: 棧橋的柱子，和底下的水。

strings.text: Below, the water is calling.
Letting Her Go
A knot of the net, and a small hand caught in it.
strings.translation: 漁網的一個結，裡面纏著一隻小手。

strings.text: She has grown still.
The Song
Four notes under the water.

The Soul has grown a little harder
The Soul has grown a little softer

The Soul — what the world without a heart has taught her: whether she still longs for him, or has grown hard.
strings.translation: 靈魂——沒有心的世界教會了她什麼：是仍在思念他，還是變得冷酷了。

strings.text: Her song
Her song has come a little nearer to him
Her song has grown a little quieter
silent
sounds
Her song — the song she sings to him: whether it sounds, or has fallen silent. Listen for it.
strings.translation: 她的歌——她唱給他的那首歌：是響著，還是已經沉默。仔細聽。

strings.text: She swore by the sea to come whenever you call.
strings.translation: 她對大海發過誓，只要你呼喚，她就會來。

strings.text: You let her go for nothing: she will come when she wants.
strings.translation: 你什麼也沒要就放她走了：她想來的時候才會來。

strings.text: You danced on the pier.
The Witch will remember: you held her to her word.
strings.translation: 女巫會記得：你要她遵守約定。

strings.text: The Witch will remember: you danced with her till dawn.
strings.translation: 女巫會記得：你和她跳舞跳到天亮。

strings.text: You promised the Soul: once a year you will come out to her.
strings.translation: 你答應過靈魂：每年出來見她一次。

strings.text: By evening the whole market knows: the fisherman from the bay is a thief.
strings.translation: 到了傍晚，整個市場都知道了：海灣的漁夫是個小偷。

strings.text: You went out for the widow’s children.
strings.translation: 你為了寡婦的孩子們出海了。

strings.text: You stayed by the water. The widow’s children went away.
strings.translation: 你留在水邊。寡婦的孩子們走了。
